normalization: seed vault, tokens and the TLS/mTLS identities pinned in the file
Date header, log timestamps, peer ports
random TLS wire bytes (encrypted_sent/received, record_sha256) are not stored: no comparison reads them

wall-clock values (elapsed_seconds) and the encrypted sender progress count are asserted against the comparison bounds at capture and recorded as the bounds midpoint / minimum (see check_profile/normalize_profile)
